subject: math
name: Mathematics
course: Linear Equations, Functions & the Pythagorean Theorem
title: Grade 8 Mathematics: Linear Equations, Functions & the Pythagorean Theorem
overview: Grade 8 Mathematics advances algebraic reasoning, proportional problem solving, geometric modeling, and statistical inference preparing students for rigorous high school pathways.
competencies: Analyze proportional relationships, rate models, and linear equations in real-world contexts.
Perform operations fluently with rational numbers, exponents, and algebraic expressions.
Apply geometric principles, coordinate transformations, and measurement formulas.
Collect, summarize, and evaluate statistical distributions and probability models.

modules.title: Integer Exponents and Scientific Notation
modules.description: Mastering laws of integer exponents, negative exponents, operations with scientific notation, and estimating large/small quantities.

topics.title: Properties of Integer Exponents
topics.description: Applying product, quotient, and power of a power exponent rules with positive and negative powers.

topics.title: Scientific Notation and Order of Magnitude
topics.description: Representing very large and microscopic quantities in scientific notation and calculating products/quotients.

modules.title: Linear Equations in One and Two Variables
modules.description: Solving multi-step linear equations with variables on both sides, identifying equations with one, infinite, or no solutions, and graphing linear equations.

topics.title: Solving Multi-Step Linear Equations
topics.description: Using the distributive property and combining like terms to solve equations with variables on both sides.

topics.title: Slope and Graphing Linear Equations
topics.description: Understanding slope as rate of change (m = rise/run), graphing y = mx + b, and interpreting intercepts.

topics.title: Systems of Two Linear Equations
topics.description: Solving systems of linear equations graphically and through algebraic substitution and elimination.

modules.title: Functions: Definition, Comparison and Modeling
modules.description: Defining a function as a rule assigning exactly one output to each input, contrasting linear vs. nonlinear functions, and modeling bivariate data.

topics.title: Defining and Evaluating Functions
topics.description: Using function tables, graphs, and algebraic equations to determine if relationships represent functions.

topics.title: Linear vs. Nonlinear Functions
topics.description: Distinguishing between constant rate of change linear functions and curved nonlinear relationships.

topics.title: Bivariate Data and Scatter Plots
topics.description: Constructing scatter plots, fitting informal trend lines of best fit, and interpreting two-way frequency tables.

modules.title: Geometry: Transformations, Congruence and the Pythagorean Theorem
modules.description: Investigating rigid transformations (translations, rotations, reflections), dilations/similarity, and proving the Pythagorean Theorem (a^2 + b^2 = c^2).

topics.title: Rigid Transformations and Congruence
topics.description: Verifying properties of rotations, reflections, and translations, and proving geometric congruence.

topics.title: Dilations, Scale Factor and Similarity
topics.description: Enlarging and reducing figures from a center of dilation to prove geometric similarity.

topics.title: The Pythagorean Theorem and Real-World Applications
topics.description: Applying a^2 + b^2 = c^2 to find unknown side lengths in right triangles and distances on coordinate planes.
